name: Complete an account pickup order with voucher
description: Verifies a signed-in customer can select sample food, apply an eligible voucher, complete demo checkout, and see a server-saved order.
steps: Sign in using the account button and complete the AppDeploy sign-in popup
Open Order online and add Coconut Fish Curry and Zanzibar Pilau Bowl
Open Cart and increase the quantity of one dish
Enter PWANI10 and apply the voucher
Continue to checkout and choose Pickup
Select Card (demo), keep Simulate success selected, and complete demo checkout
Open My orders
expected: The total reflects quantities and a 10% discount, no card details are requested, a reference is shown, and the order appears in the current account's saved order history.

name: Reject invalid voucher and failed payment
description: Verifies invalid checkout inputs and demo payment failure do not create a completed order.
steps: Add Cassava Crisps to the cart
Apply the invented code NOTREAL and observe the warning
Continue to checkout and choose Pickup
Select Simulate failure and click Complete demo payment and order
Return to Cart
expected: The invalid code is rejected, payment failure shows an error, no order confirmation is created, and the cart contents remain available for retry.

name: Complete guest pickup order on mobile and retain history
description: Verifies a guest can place a pickup order at mobile width and find it after reloading the page.
steps: Open Order online on a mobile viewport and add Mango Lime Cooler
Refresh the browser and open Cart
Continue to checkout, select Pickup and Pay on pickup
Confirm the demo order
Open My orders and advance the guest order status once
Refresh and open My orders again
expected: The cart survives refresh, the guest receives a reference, the status changes, and the guest order remains available in the same browser.

name: Sign out and keep account orders private
description: Verifies account session state and the authenticated boundary around server-stored orders.
steps: Sign in through the account button
Open My account and choose Sign out
Open My orders while signed out
Use the Sign in for saved order history action if there are no guest orders
expected: The account session is cleared from the interface and server-saved orders are not returned to the anonymous visitor because the orders endpoint requires authentication.

name: Search and filter the mobile menu
description: Verifies customers can quickly find menu items on mobile and see an accurate empty result state.
steps: Open Order online
Search for Mango
Choose Drinks
Change the search phrase to a non-matching name
Clear the search and read the demo notice
expected: Search and category filters combine correctly, no-match results show a helpful empty state, and the app remains identified as a fictional demonstration.
